citations.quote: The woman’s son, Ronn Tristan Perez, who is a Filipino-American reality television star based in the United States, arrived at the NBI’s Homicide Division on Thursday to seek the investigation into the death of his mother.
In an interview with reporters, Perez said his mother underwent four cosmetic procedures — such as liposuction, Brazilian butt lift, tummy tuck, and body tite for arms — on March 2.
According to Perez, his mother started becoming pale after undergoing the four plastic surgery procedures at the celebrity surgeon’s clinic.
Perez claimed he asked the clinic for his mother’s medical records but did not receive all of the documents he wanted to see.
